name: worker-test-0f3493dd03/multiple-receive-type-checking-e.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: supported statement list does not include named worker declarations or worker send statements.
## Expressions: "[Start action]" and "[Wait action]" are listed, but worker receive actions (including multiple receive) are not.
reason: The essential behavior is duplicate-key rejection and contextual type checking of multiple worker receives. Named workers, asynchronous/synchronous worker sends, and multiple receive actions are outside the documented supported lists; start/wait support does not cover worker messaging. Thus the whole negative case requires a feature regardless of its otherwise ordinary type declarations.
unsupported_constructs: Multiple receive action: <- {a: w1, b: w1}, including duplicate-key and contextual-type diagnostics
test_design_notes: Contains both @error expectations and explicitly OK receive cases; both rely on unsupported worker messaging.
